PUC DOCKET NO. 58185 
SOAH DOCKET NO. 473-25-20558 
APPLICATION OF CENTERPOINT 
§ 
PUBLIC UTILITY COMMISSION 
ENERGY HOUSTON ELECTRIC, LLC 
§ 
TO ADJUST ITS ENERGY 
§ 
OF TEXAS 
EFFICIENCY COST RECOVERY 
§ 
FACTOR 
§ 
ORDER 
This Order addresses the application of CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC to 
adjust its energy-efficiency cost recovery factor (EECRF) for program year 2026 under PURA' 
§ 39.905 and 16 Texas Administrative Code (TAC) § 25.182. 
CenterPoint Houston filed an 
unopposed agreement among the parties in this proceeding. Under the agreement, CenterPoint 
Houston's EECRF will recover approximately $95,837,175 in revenue annually, reflecting an 
incremental increase of $33,096,829 as compared to the amount approved by the Commission in 
Docket No. 56690,2 CenterPoint Houston's last EECRF proceeding. The Commission adjusts 
CenterPoint Houston's EECRF to the extent provided in this Order. 
I. 
Findings of Fact 
The Commission makes the following findings of fact. 
Applicant 
1. 
CenterPoint Houston is a Texas limited liability company registered with the Texas 
secretary of state under filing number 800119842. 
2. 
CenterPoint Houston owns and operates for compensation in Texas facilities and 
equipment to transmit and distribute electricity in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas 
region. 
3. 
CenterPoint Houston holds certificate of convenience and necessity number 30086 to 
provide service to the public within its certificated area. 
' Public Utility Regulatory Act, Tex. Util. Code §§ 11.001-66.017. 
2 Application of CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC to Adjust Its Energy Efficiency Cost Recovery 
Factor , Docket No . 56690 , Order ( Dec . 12 , 2024 ).

PUC Docket No. 58185 
SOAH Docket No. 473-25-20558 
Order 
Page 2 of 20 
Application 
4. 
On May 30,2025, CenterPoint Houston filed an application to adjust its EECRF, effective 
March 1, 2026. 
5. 
In the application, CenterPoint Houston sought Commission approval to adjust its EECRF 
to recover $95,837,175 during program year 2026, which includes the following: 
a. 
CenterPoint Houston's forecasted energy-efficiency costs of $50,155,355 in 
program year 2026; 
b. 
projected evaluation, measurement, and verification expenses in the amount of 
$576,924 in program year 2026 for the evaluation of program year 2025; 
c. 
a charge of $4,298,232, plus interest in the amount of $448,229, for CenterPoint 
Houston's net under-recovery of program year 2024 energy efficiency costs; 
d. 
a performance bonus of $40,313,445 for 2024 program achievements; and 
e. 
rate-case expenses incurred in CenterPoint Houston's most recent EECRF 
proceeding, Docket No. 56690, in the amounts of $36,245 for CenterPoint Houston 
and $8,745 for the City of Houston. 
6. 
In Order No. 1 filed on October 20,2025, the administrative law judge (ALJ) found the 
application sufficient. 
Notice 
7. 
On May 30,2025, CenterPoint Houston sent notice of the application by first-class mail to 
the following: (a) all parties of record in CenterPoint Houston's most recent EECRF 
proceeding, Docket No. 56690; (b) all retail electric providers that were authorized to 
provide service in CenterPoint Houston's service area at the time the EECRF application 
was filed; (c) all parties of record in CenterPoint Houston's most recent base-rate case, 
Docket No. 56211;3 and (d) the Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs, the 
state agency that administers the federal weatherization program. 
3 Application of CenterPoint Energy Houston Electric, LLC for Authority to Change Rates, Docket 
No. 56211, Order (Mar. 13,2025).
